notes: Loop 2, HEAD 2712407. I tested live on dev.mjs --no-build :3321 (open) and :3322 (WHATIF_BETA_CODES=test-code-123), plus SDK clients, then stopped both. What changed: state tokens are capped and cleaned (state.ts:76-99). A 52K-char deflate bomb that inflates to 40 MB fails in 152 ms, and a 190 KB rehearsal token autoplays in 34 ms. classifyQuestion routes hiring, hours and weather honestly. Interview text no longer mentions submit. Unknown keys get a 'did you mean'. 'ca. 140', '10ish' and '1.500 €' parse. stdio falls back to localhost. improvements: src/mcp/tools.ts:1021-1029 (whatif_run_scenarios inputSchema) and src/mcp/messages.ts:115 / :329 (ci_run_next, all four languages): add `state: stateInsteadArg.optional()` to whatif_run_scenarios and whatif_check_inputs, resolved with resolveCtx(args, { allowState: true }), and make `template` optional with state. Why: input schemas and errors. Today the ready check_inputs result tells the model to pass its `state` to run_scenarios. The schema drops it silently: {state} alone is a -32602 'expected lunch_offer|price_change'. {template, state} answers 'Noch nicht bereit: 6 Zahlen fehlen noch' and 'Als Nächstes fragen: Wie viele Gäste…', so the model asks Selin again for six numbers she just gave. This is the loop-1 'state in and out' bug, one step earlier. Done when check_inputs → run_scenarios {state} gives the analysis. Add a test that every tool a result text names next to `state` really accepts `state`.

src/mcp/http.ts:269-279 and scripts/dev.mjs + the Vercel routes: make the closed-beta 401 reach someone in real hosts. With an SDK client that has an authProvider (as Claude Code and claude.ai connectors do), the 401 starts OAuth discovery. /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and /register are all 404, and the error ends up as 'HTTP 404: Invalid OAuth error response … Not found: /register'. The bilingual message and the contact are lost. Only clients without auth support see it. Fix: send `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="<short EN+DE message>"`, and answer those OAuth paths with a JSON OAuth error whose error_description is betaMessage(). Then check what Claude Code `/mcp` and claude.ai 'Add custom connector' show for a URL without a code. Also say on /connect what that error looks like and that it means 'code missing'. Done when a QA check runs the SDK client with an authProvider against a beta server and the thrown error contains 'Einladungscode'.

src/mcp/tools.ts:651 (classifyQuestion, 'results'): returning with results needs a RESULT/TEST word and a BACK word, so common German and Spanish phrasings fall through. 'Wir haben den Test gemacht, hier sind die Ergebnisse' and 'Ich habe die Zahlen vom Test: 47 Gäste am Tag' come back unclear. So does 'Ya terminé la prueba, estos son los resultados'. 'Hier sind meine Ergebnisse vom Mittagsangebot' and 'Two weeks of the lunch deal are over: 47 lunch guests a day' are read as a new lunch decision and get the six lunch questions again. Treat RESULT_WORDS alone, or TEST_WORDS with a count or 'gemacht / zu Ende / terminé / are over', as results. Why: SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS step 7 ('back with test counts, even in a new chat') depends on it, and German is the default. Done when these five rows sit in the test table at test/mcp.test.ts:413 and pass.

README.md:7 ('Live: (after deploy …)'): deploy the beta and publish its address. The component is the *public* MCP server, and as shipped a judge still cannot paste a URL into claude.ai. Everything verified here ran on localhost. Set WHATIF_SITE_URL, WHATIF_BETA_CODES and WHATIF_BETA_CONTACT in Vercel. Put the real https URL in the README, on /connect and in the skill zip. Done when `curl https://<site>/api/mcp` returns the info JSON with beta.required true and the README has no placeholder.

src/mcp/tools.ts:117 (inputsArg), :1117 (customer_mix), :1470 (observed) and :1008 (ignored_inputs): limit the records and the echo. z.record has no key cap, so 25,000 unknown keys (711 KB body) take 0.5 s and return a 1.5 MB response, because structuredContent lists every ignored key. Cap each record at about 60 keys (refine or check in splitInputs), and return at most 8 ignored keys plus a count. While there, clean the German path of the tool texts the model relays. rs_who prints the raw attitude id ('Jonas (Freiberufler, sceptical)'). messages.ts:358 says '1 brauchen einen neuen Versuch' (use plural()). un_by_hand starts with 'Otherwise' even when no mapping line came before it ('hire a part-timer'). Done when a 25k-key call is refused in under 50 ms, and no German result contains English attitude ids.
